Simulate diagnostic circular-circular data

Source: R/directional-diagnostics.R
simulate_tor_diagnostic.Rd

Simulate diagnostic circular-circular data

Usage

simulate_tor_diagnostic(
  n = 900,
  scenario = c("independent_concentrated", "diagonal", "doubling", "bifurcation",
    "uniform_marginal_dependence"),
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

n

Number of observations.

scenario

Diagnostic scenario.

seed

Optional random seed.

Value

A data frame with theta, phi and scenario.

See also

Other directional diagnostics: autoplot.diagnostic_atlas_data(), diagnostic_atlas_data(), diagnostic_scenarios(), plot_classical_comparison(), plot_diagnostic_atlas(), simulate_cyl_diagnostic()
